verbs.name: jobs.status
verbs.description: Status of one background job (probe/proxy/transcribe/perception/render/judge). jobs domain replaces media.status. Pass optional expected_origin_path_sha256 from project.state.project_identity when polling a project-owned UI job; a changed open project returns conflict before any job lookup. Omit it for the backward-compatible unscoped API.
verbs.result: JobRecord {job_id, kind, state: queued|running|done|failed, completion?: success|done_with_warnings, outcome?: succeeded|failed|cancelled|interrupted|superseded, outcome_reason?: completed|completed_with_warnings|true_failure|user_cancelled|project_switch_cancelled|restart_interrupted|superseded, progress 0..1, message?, queue?:{resource,max_running}, waiting_on?:{job_id,kind}, retry?:{eligible,reason?,root_job_id,attempt,retry_of?,retried_by?}, error?, result?}. retry is the engine-authored public eligibility and lineage projection; its replay descriptor and fingerprints remain private. message is the latest durable human-readable progress or terminal phase; it is absent on queued/legacy records until a worker reports one. queue is present only while a limited job waits for the named shared local resource and states its concurrency capacity; it clears when the slot is acquired or the job becomes terminal. waiting_on is present only while an orchestrator awaits the named active child and is relationship evidence, not a retry promise. state remains backward-compatible; outcome/outcome_reason explain terminal cause and are absent on legacy persisted records. completion is present on newly completed jobs; done_with_warnings means the result is usable but partial and its result.warnings must be inspected.

verbs.name: jobs.list
verbs.description: All job records of this server run, newest first (status bar + agent overview). Active records retain their latest human-readable message so a reconnect can restore the current phase without waiting for another progress event.
verbs.result: {jobs: JobRecord[], persistence_notices: [{code:'job_record_quarantined',record,message,quarantine}]}. persistence_notices is empty unless project recovery quarantined malformed job JSON; quarantine is relative to the project's jobs directory.

verbs.name: jobs.cancel
verbs.description: Cancel one active background job from this server run. Pass optional expected_origin_path_sha256 from project.state.project_identity for a project-owned UI job; a changed open project returns conflict before job lookup or cancellation. Omitting it retains the backward-compatible unscoped API. state remains failed with code job_cancelled for client compatibility, while jobs.status records outcome:cancelled and outcome_reason:user_cancelled. Cancellation waits for tracked blocking workers and their synchronous child processes to finish; if the bounded drain period expires, job_cancel_pending tells the caller to wait and retry instead of falsely claiming the worker stopped. Already-finished, recovered, or unknown jobs are rejected with structured errors.

verbs.name: jobs.retry
verbs.description: Admit one fresh durable child for an eligible failed engine-owned retry descriptor; this is never generic historical request replay. screen_record.export retries require a default output, the active project's exact revision, and SHA-256 fingerprints of its source, EditPlan, and recorder audio inputs before reserving a fresh output lease. verify.rerun retries require the active revision, immutable RenderReceipt, rendered-output hash, and exact receipt/output fingerprints before a fresh output-only verification pass. The source is consumed and linked to exactly one child atomically; a second retry returns conflict. Explicit Save As exports, cancellations, successes, superseded jobs, legacy records, unresolved persistence errors, changed inputs, and changed project revisions are ineligible and must start a new job.

job_id.description: Eligible failed screen_record.export or verify.rerun job id with an engine-owned retry descriptor

verbs.result: {job_id, retry_of, root_job_id, attempt, status:'queued', path, format:'mp4'|'gif'} for a recorder export, or {job_id, retry_of, root_job_id, attempt, status:'queued', render_id, output_hash} for output-only verification. Poll jobs.status for progress and terminal result.
